messages:
marta: Quick VO bug: when opening the invoke panel VoiceOver focuses the close button before the first parameter. Repro on macOS Safari.
ryan: thanks — sounds like DOM order vs visual layout. can you paste repro steps?
marta: open playground -> pick function -> click "Invoke" -> VO+RightArrow. focus lands on close instead of first input.
samir: probable cause = close button earlier in DOM. quick fix: set tabindex=-1 on close and programmatically focus first param when panel opens, or reorder DOM and use CSS positioning.
olivia: copy nit: we show both "Run" and "Invoke" across UI. propose standardizing on "Invoke" in playground for consistency and a11y.
ryan: +1. avoid tooltip-only clarifications and keep visible label == accessible name.
marta: contrast note: run-history badges fail AA on dark theme. suggest token tweak to #245a9a.
samir: will update theme token and add sr-only span for variant names so SR users hear the variant without expanding entries.
olivia: add aria-live feedback for "Copy to prompt" -> "Copied parameters to prompt" so screen reader users get confirmation.
devex-bot: created DEVEX-4011 "Invoke panel: VoiceOver focus order, label standardization, contrast token" -> https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-4011
ryan: plan: keep change set minimal (aria attrs + copy + token). aim for patch release this week. marta will validate VO after PR.
